basic_details.job_title: Directorate of Horticulture Nagaland Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Directorate of Horticulture, Government of Nagaland, Kohima has invited applications from eligible and indigenous inhabitants of Nagaland for 2 (two) Driver posts at Pay Matrix Level-3. Application forms are issued from the Directorate's office in Kohima from 17 November 2026 for ₹200 in cash, and applications must be received by 30 November 2026.

qualification.details: Who can apply: eligible and indigenous inhabitants of Nagaland. Educational qualification: minimum Class-VIII Passed. Experience: valid Driving License with minimum 2 (Two) years driving experience. Age: 21 -32 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date. Age relaxation: the upper age limit is relaxable by 5 (five) years for candidates belonging to SC/ST. Serving Government employees: the upper age is relaxable equal to years of service served, subject to a maximum of 5 years. Reservation: 1 (one) post is reserved for Chakhesang Tribe as per the existing reservation policy of the Govt. of Nagaland. | The notice gives the pay only as Level-3 and prints no rupee amount. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Application forms are issued from the Office of the Directorate of Horticulture, Nagaland, Kohima, from 17 November 2026 during office hours. The form fee is ₹200/- (Rupees two hundred only), paid in cash and non-refundable. The notice does not print a postal address, an email address or a mode of submission for the completed application. It states only that applications received after 30 November 2026 will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Who can apply: eligible and indigenous inhabitants of Nagaland. Educational qualification: minimum Class-VIII Passed. Experience: valid Driving License with minimum 2 (Two) years driving experience. Age: 21 -32 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date. Age relaxation: the upper age limit is relaxable by 5 (five) years for candidates belonging to SC/ST. Serving Government employees: the upper age is relaxable equal to years of service served, subject to a maximum of 5 years. Reservation: 1 (one) post is reserved for Chakhesang Tribe as per the existing reservation policy of the Govt. of Nagaland. The notice gives the pay only as Level-3 and prints no rupee amount. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Valid Driving License with minimum 2 (Two) years driving experience Aadhar Card Educational Certificate ST/Indigenous Certificate Birth Certificate Medical Fitness Certificate Unemployment Card 2 (two) passport photos and contact number(s) For in-service candidates: "No Objection Certificate" duly counter-signed by the concerned Head of Department with Name & Office Seal, along with the initial date of appointment

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection involves a Driving Test and an Oral Interview. The Driving Test includes knowledge on signage, MV rules and vehicle parts. The date, time and venue of both will be communicated individually to the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many Driver posts are vacant in the Directorate of Horticulture, Nagaland?
faq.answer: There are 2 (two) Driver posts at Pay Matrix Level-3. One post is reserved for the Chakhesang Tribe.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Nagaland Horticulture Driver post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 30 November 2026. Applications received after that date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is Class-VIII Passed. Candidates also need a valid Driving License with minimum 2 (Two) years driving experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 -32 years. The upper limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application form costs ₹200/- in cash and is non-refundable. Applicants who applied under the advertisement dated 20th March 2026 must apply afresh but need not pay for the form.

faq.question: Q6. How do I get the application form?
faq.answer: Application forms are issued from the Office of the Directorate of Horticulture, Nagaland, Kohima, from 17 November 2026 during office hours.

faq.question: Q7. How are Driver candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates take a Driving Test, covering signage, MV rules and vehicle parts, and an Oral Interview. The date, time and venue will be communicated individually.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only eligible and indigenous inhabitants of Nagaland can apply, as the notice states.

faq.question: Q9. Can serving Government employees apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The upper age is relaxable equal to years of service, up to a maximum of 5 years. They must produce a "No Objection Certificate" counter-signed by the Head of Department with Name & Office Seal, along with the initial date of appointment.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if the documents are incomplete?
faq.answer: Applications with incomplete documents or an expired Driving License will be summarily rejected.
